# Facetime

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Facetimes the given contact.

## Syntax

~~~~text
facetime(type: <#Enumeration (WFFaceTimeType)#>, contact: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
facetime(type: Video, contact: Contact)
~~~~
